description: CommonGround plugin hooks (SER-141/143). SessionStart: first-boot detection (nudge to /commonground:point when signed in but the project is not pointed at a wiki) and, on an initialized project, a wiki-awareness summary plus a refresh of the team keyword cache. Scoped to "startup" (SER-182): SessionStart also fires on resume/clear/compact, and re-injecting the same orientation block at every compaction is how ambient guidance turns into noise — fixing it at the trigger beats de-duplicating downstream. UserPromptSubmit: the deterministic Code auto-trigger — when a prompt mentions a cached team keyword, nudge Claude to consult the wiki first. PreToolUse (SER-217): the publish guard — no CommonGround write lands without explicit consent, DENY in local-clone mode (where the MCP write tools are the wrong path per SER-184) and ASK in MCP mode (where the write IS the publish and is live the instant it lands). Matched broadly on "mcp__" with the precision in code, because a narrow regex matcher cannot be verified without actually publishing something. The first two hooks are fail-open; the guard is fail-SAFE on its verdict (uncertainty resolves to ask, never to allow) and fail-open only on a crash, so a hook hiccup never wedges a session.
